findings.title: The new sit-down zoom test reads cam.zoom on the same frame zoomTo is called, so it passes with or without the fog gate
findings.claim: Task 9's 'sitting at the Helm frames the enemy only when it is seen' checks `rt.cameras.helm.zoom` right after the sitting `scene.draw`, and runs no later frame. zoomTo only sets `targetZoom` (and `zoomFrom` and `zoomT = 0`). `zoom` itself only moves in updateCamera, which the runtime's frame calls, not the scene. So `zoom === z0` holds whether or not the `fogView.seen.enemy` gate is in, and the test can't catch the leak R1-F5 asked it to cover.
findings.evidence: plan L2446-2450 (reads `rt.cameras.helm.zoom` after the second draw, with no later `rt.frame`). camera.ts:61-65: zoomTo sets `cam.targetZoom = target` and leaves `cam.zoom` alone. camera.ts:90-91: `zoomT += dt` eases `zoom` inside updateCamera. runtime.ts:150 and :534 call updateCamera. scene.ts:250 calls zoomTo inside draw.
findings.why: The sit-zoom leak would come back unnoticed. A test written against R1-F5 that can't fail gives false assurance.
findings.fix: Assert on `rt.cameras.helm.targetZoom` (read z0 from targetZoom as well). Add a converse case: move the Hunter to `own.x + 600`, sit again (or use a fresh runtime), and expect `targetZoom` to differ from z0. Then the test fails without the gate and passes with it.
